# XFlow Industrial Systems — FAQ

> Fictional demo company. This file is test data, not a real product specification.

## Company and support

XFlow Industrial Systems supplies industrial liquid-transfer pumps to customers in Canada and the United States.

Standard technical support hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time, excluding statutory holidays in British Columbia.

For markets outside Canada and the United States, customers must contact the sales team to confirm availability, certifications, shipping and local service coverage.

## Warranty

- NF-200: 24-month limited warranty from the shipment date.
- NF-500: 36-month limited warranty from the shipment date.
- The warranty covers manufacturing defects under normal operating conditions.
- Damage caused by incorrect voltage, installation outside the manual, dry running, freezing, misuse or unauthorized modifications is excluded.
- Warranty service requires the product serial number and proof of purchase.

## Shipping and delivery

Standard in-stock orders are normally prepared for shipment within 7–12 business days after order confirmation. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed delivery date. Actual availability and delivery commitments must be confirmed by a human sales representative.

The AI assistant is not authorized to promise a shipping date, delivery date, price, discount, contractual term or inventory reservation.

## Pricing

Public pricing is not included in this knowledge base. Prices vary by configuration, voltage, accessories, destination and commercial terms. A human sales representative must provide or approve quotations and discounts.

## Returns

Unopened standard products may be eligible for return within 30 calendar days of delivery, subject to an approved Return Material Authorization, or RMA. Custom-configured products are not returnable unless XFlow confirms a manufacturing defect.

Customers must not ship a return before receiving an RMA number.

## Product selection

The NF-200 is intended for lower-flow industrial transfer applications. The NF-500 is intended for higher-flow installations and requires three-phase power. Final product selection must consider fluid properties, operating temperature, pressure, electrical supply and local requirements.

## Safety

NF-Series pumps are not approved for drinking-water systems, explosive atmospheres or flammable liquids. Installation and electrical work must be completed by qualified personnel.

When a customer reports smoke, sparks, severe leakage, an electrical smell or another possible immediate safety issue, the assistant should stop normal troubleshooting and transfer the conversation to a human.

## Competitors

XFlow does not provide comparative judgments about competitors through the AI assistant. The assistant may describe documented XFlow features but must not claim that a competitor is unsafe, inferior or unsuitable.
